# PRIVATE. Which province of a state is its city, port, farm, mine or wood hub.
#
# Nothing in the engine reads a hub back, so the table is generated by tools/make_compat.py
# and looked up by state region. An answer whose state region no longer matches is discarded,
# so a changed map falls back to terrain names.
#
# Country scope. Fills mbga_hub_city, _port, _farm, _mine and _wood for the state in
# mbga_active_state_region.

# One kind of hub, read out of its own map. $KIND$ is substituted when the game loads.
#
# The map is opened by mbga_unwrap_hub_<kind> rather than here: a parameter inside a quoted
# event target link comes out mangled, so that one line is the only thing written five times.
mbga_read_hub = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_map = mbga_hubmap_$KIND$ }
		every_key_in_variable_map = {
			variable = mbga_hubmap_$KIND$
			limit = { this = scope:mbga_hub_region }
			save_scope_as = mbga_hub_key

			scope:mbga_hub_reader = {
				mbga_unwrap_hub_$KIND$ = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:mbga_hub_found = {
							state.state_region ?= scope:mbga_hub_region
						}
					}
					set_variable = { name = mbga_hub_$KIND$ value = scope:mbga_hub_found }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

mbga_unwrap_hub_city = {
	"variable_map(mbga_hubmap_city|scope:mbga_hub_key)" = { save_scope_as = mbga_hub_found }
}

mbga_unwrap_hub_port = {
	"variable_map(mbga_hubmap_port|scope:mbga_hub_key)" = { save_scope_as = mbga_hub_found }
}

mbga_unwrap_hub_farm = {
	"variable_map(mbga_hubmap_farm|scope:mbga_hub_key)" = { save_scope_as = mbga_hub_found }
}

mbga_unwrap_hub_mine = {
	"variable_map(mbga_hubmap_mine|scope:mbga_hub_key)" = { save_scope_as = mbga_hub_found }
}

mbga_unwrap_hub_wood = {
	"variable_map(mbga_hubmap_wood|scope:mbga_hub_key)" = { save_scope_as = mbga_hub_found }
}

mbga_load_hubs_of_state = {
	save_scope_as = mbga_hub_reader

	remove_variable = mbga_hub_city
	remove_variable = mbga_hub_port
	remove_variable = mbga_hub_farm
	remove_variable = mbga_hub_mine
	remove_variable = mbga_hub_wood

	# 3072 entries, so it is built once and then answers every state for the rest of the
	# session.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = mbga_hub_maps_ready } }
		set_variable = mbga_hub_maps_ready
		mbga_fill_hub_maps = yes

		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_map = mbga_hubmap_city }
			debug_log = "MBGA|hubs|the hub table was read, hubs are named"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "MBGA|hubs|no hub table for this map, rows fall back to terrain names"
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = mbga_active_state_region }
		var:mbga_active_state_region = { save_scope_as = mbga_hub_region }

		mbga_read_hub = { KIND = city }
		mbga_read_hub = { KIND = port }
		mbga_read_hub = { KIND = farm }
		mbga_read_hub = { KIND = mine }
		mbga_read_hub = { KIND = wood }
	}
}
